# Mylo Kaye — Dynamics 365 Customer Insights tools

> A curated portfolio of open-source tools, prototypes and practical guidance for Dynamics 365 Customer Insights, forms and campaign operations.

Canonical site: https://mylokaye.info/
Author: Mylo Kaye
GitHub: https://github.com/mylokaye
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mylokaye/

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://mylokaye.info/): Overview of current Dynamics 365 and customer-experience projects.
- [About Mylo Kaye](https://mylokaye.info/about/): Professional focus, working approach and contact links.
- [Form Debugger for Dynamics 365](https://mylokaye.info/form-debugger/): Free Chrome and Edge extension for bypassing cache while testing Dynamics 365 Customer Insights forms. Current documented version: 1.3.0.
- [Dynamics 365 Customer Insights Forms Skill](https://mylokaye.info/d365-form-skill/): Alpha, pre-development guidance project for inspecting and safely editing exported forms. Current documented version: 1.0.1.
- [Pattens](https://mylokaye.info/pattens/): Privacy-focused campaign-operations toolkit for planning, naming and UTM workflows.
- [Agentic Form](https://mylokaye.info/agentic-form/): Four-step B2B inquiry-form prototype with validation and local draft recovery.
- [Privacy](https://mylokaye.info/privacy.html): Data handling for this website and the Form Debugger extension.

## Source repositories and live tools

- Form Debugger source: https://github.com/mylokaye/Form-Debugger-D365
- Forms Skill source: https://github.com/mylokaye/d365-form-skill
- Pattens source: https://github.com/mylokaye/Pattens
- Pattens live tool: https://pattens.tech/
- Agentic Form source: https://github.com/mylokaye/Agentic-Form
- Agentic Form live prototype: https://agentic-form.mylokaye.info/
